question: What is the chief particular of fore-tithi piercing, dividing day-night in three?
premises: fore-tithi piercing union is most principal here as the particular
in day-night indeed, having made in three parts
inference: Day-night tripartition makes fore-tithi piercing the chief particular.
plain_english: Fore-tithi piercing union, most principal this particular here — in day-night indeed, having made in three parts: first-middle-last division.
